attributes.headline: The things you keep are trying to tell you something.
attributes.subhead: A narrow software-factory trial that turns any copy-and-pasteable artifact into a source-grounded, personally curated zine—without replacing the person’s point of view.

cardInfo.name: Factory Trial 04 — Commonplace
cardInfo.summary: An article-led 5-reuse / 10-build proposal for transforming mixed clipboard fragments into an auditable personal zine.
cardInfo.notes: Proposal authored 2026-07-21. Crawl Source is treated as an assumed reusable, provider-backed typed command and must pass the search-first gate. Platform services remain outside the artifact budget.
